signIn.title: Sign in to your courses
signIn.body: Sign in with your organisation account. This site never sees your password; your session ends when you sign out or when it expires.

courses.join: Join a course with its code

join.title: Join a course
join.intro: Type the course code your teacher gave you, or check the one the link carried, then join. You join once: the course then stays in My courses.
join.hint: Eight letters and digits. Upper or lower case, spaces and hyphens do not matter.
join.notFound: No open course has this code. Check it with your teacher: a code may have been changed or switched off.
join.staff: You teach this course, so you cannot join it as a student.
join.failed: The course could not be joined. Try again in a moment.

course.joined: You have joined this course. It is now in My courses.
course.notOpen: This course is not open to students yet.
course.notLearner: You are not a student of this course.
course.failed: The course could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

outcomes.heading: What you will learn
outcomes.empty: This course names no learning outcome.

attempt.heading: Your attempt
attempt.intro: Write your answer and submit it. A submitted attempt is recorded as it is and cannot be changed; you may submit another one.
attempt.label: Your answer
attempt.confirm: Submit this attempt? It is recorded as it is and cannot be changed.
attempt.submitted: Your attempt was submitted. It is listed below, and your assessors can now evaluate it.
attempt.conflict: This attempt was already sent with another text. Reload the page and submit it again.
attempt.failed: The attempt could not be submitted. Try again: it is recorded only once.

attempts.heading: Your attempts at this activity
attempts.none: You have not submitted an attempt here yet.
attempts.evaluated: Evaluated ({{mode}}). The levels and reasons are in My progress.

ask.heading: Ask for help
ask.intro: The Socratic coach helps you find the answer yourself, with questions; it does not give you the solution. The Teacher explains. On this activity the coach stays with you until you choose the Teacher.
ask.label: Your question
ask.confirm: The coach is guiding you on this activity. Ask the Teacher for an explanation instead? The coach then leaves this activity until you ask it again.
ask.conflict: This question was already sent with another text. Reload the page and ask again.
ask.failed: The question could not be sent. Try again: it is sent only once.

questions.heading: Your questions on this activity
questions.none: You have not asked anything here yet.
questions.stillSocratic: The coach is still guiding you on this activity, so the Teacher did not answer. Choose “Ask the Teacher instead” to switch.
questions.failed: This question could not be answered. Ask it again in a moment.
